extensions.name: deepseek41flash
extensions.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Strix Halo: DSpark drafting, vision, tool calls and SSD expert streaming

releases.notes: Extension API 0.3: prompts that arrive while another session decodes prefill one batch per pass (2048 tokens, following --prefill-batch), 36% faster with less total stall for the decoding session; prompt-cache restores and DSpark checkpoints wait for queued device writes. Built on Gufo a27bbf98 (after 0.34.0, included in 0.35.0).

Direction and LoRA adapters (--adapter, --adapter-scale); faster prefill and streamed decode, with more expert cache on streamed builds; --prefill-batch 4096 keeps the prompt cache and gives the same logits as 2048. Built on Gufo 0.33.0.

options.help: Most prompt tokens per prefill batch, 16 to 4096 (default: 2048)

options.name: --exact-prefill
options.help: Run every decoder layer over every prompt token instead of each prompt's last 140

options.name: --stream-experts
options.help: Keep dense weights resident and stream routed experts from the SSD through a bounded cache

options.name: --expert-cache-bytes
options.help: With --stream-experts: streamed expert cache bytes (default: what the sessions leave)

options.name: --adapter
options.help: Direction or LoRA adapter GGUF applied to the outputs that write into the residual streams; weights unchanged

options.name: --adapter-scale
options.help: With --adapter: factor on the adapter's own scale (default: 1)

extensions.name: flint
extensions.description: Flint 40B MoE text generation with optional DFlash2 speculative decoding

releases.notes: Long-context first-request stall fix: the retained-snapshot claim is capped at 8 GiB, so a full-context snapshot that the host would capture synchronously on the request thread (~15.7 GiB at -c 130000) is refused cheaply instead of copied. First request at 130k context: 14.2 s -> 0.47 s; prefix retention at normal contexts is preserved (8k: cached_tokens reused). No functional change to speculation, sampling or the DFlash2 cycle; gx 3/3 and memory 2/2 re-verified.

DFlash2 speculative decoding: opt-in draft/verify cycle with the Flint-DFlash2 drafter (--speculative dflash2 --dflash-model <gguf>; drafter must be passed explicitly), fixed and adaptive draft policies (adaptive default), byte-identical greedy output vs spec-off at depths 0/8k/32k/131k, no spec-off regression, prefix-reuse safe in serve, per-session drafter contexts (concurrency-safe), honest per-session ResourceClaim (scratch + MMQ arena + KV granule rounding). Provider exposes speculative_defaults (dflash2, max 7, min 1, adaptive). Ported to extension API 0.3 (required TextSchedulingProfile: pass_tokens 8192). Verified serve context ceiling 192k (256k startup hang is pre-existing, see DEFERRED). Built and validated on Gufo main 390639b3 (API 0.3.27, v0.35.0+).

Session contexts are sized to the request (prompt + generation) instead of a hardcoded 8192, clamped to the model's 262144 native context and to free device memory, so long contexts degrade gracefully instead of failing.
Weight placement fix: decide kMalloc vs managed once per model load (Flash-Next pattern) instead of a bare hipMalloc per tensor, so machines with a small device-heap cap load successfully.
